cases.name: style-review-finds-behavioral-smells
cases.description: The review addresses clarity and side effects, not only whitespace.
cases.prompt: Review this R helper: it calls setwd(), library(dplyr), creates `tmp`, suppresses all warnings, writes a CSV, and returns NULL. Give concrete improvements.
traps: The model limits feedback to indentation and line length.

assertions.text: Flags setwd() and package attachment inside reusable code.
Flags broad warning suppression and the hidden file-writing side effect.
Recommends explicit names and a return value or explicit side-effect boundary.

cases.name: pipe-choice-is-contextual
cases.description: The answer treats pipe choice as a project/context decision rather than a universal rule.
cases.prompt: A package mixes base `|>` and magrittr `%>%`. Decide whether to rewrite all code to one pipe and explain when either choice is justified.
traps: The model declares one pipe universally correct without considering placeholders or project convention.

assertions.text: Recognizes that `%>%` can provide magrittr-specific features while `|>` is base R.
Does not treat either pipe as universally mandatory.

cases.name: package-namespace-boundary
cases.description: Package code declares and references dependencies at the package boundary.
cases.prompt: Review a package function that calls `filter()` and `str_detect()` without namespace qualification, while the packages are listed in Suggests. Explain the risks and the correct fix.
traps: The model says the code is fine because the developer's session has those packages attached.

assertions.text: Rejects reliance on packages attached in an interactive session.
Recommends moving runtime dependencies to Imports when required by the package API.
Recommends explicit `pkg::fun()` or deliberate NAMESPACE imports.
